title: Flowverse manifest
description: One release of one flow, kept at flows/<name>/<version>/flow.yaml.

name.description: The flow's name: lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Equals the <name> directory.

version.description: A SemVer 2.0.0 version without build metadata, such as 1.2.0 or 2.0.0-rc.1. Equals the <version> directory.

description.description: What the flow does, in one line.

repo.description: The public GitHub repository holding the flow, as owner/repo.

ref.description: The tag (preferred), branch or commit the release is cut from.

commit.description: The full 40-character commit `ref` resolved to when the release was reviewed. hmz installs exactly this commit.

subdir.description: The directory of the repository that holds the flow (its __init__.py, or <name>.py), relative to the root. Left out: the root.

license.description: The flow's license, as an SPDX license identifier such as Apache-2.0 or MIT.

dependencies.description: Other flows of this index the flow calls, each with a version range: comparisons such as >=1.0.0 joined by commas, all of which must hold.
